title: Example player chrome is missing until POST /jobs succeeds

comments.author: ryan
comments.text:
Live aurit.us/examples/basic: after boot, Play exists in shadow DOM (Ready, ~23s audio). First paint has no chrome because boot awaits POST /jobs before mountPlayer. Empty .auritus-player-host looks like sage page background. Accessibility snapshot also omits the shadow Play button.

Fix: first-paint placeholder plus mount chrome before createJob; 404 while creating is waiting, not failure.

right_now_summary: A placeholder now shows player controls before job creation, avoiding a blank first paint while POST /jobs loads.
